models.name: TabPFN-3.5 base
models.availability: Released; official local checkpoint/model card verified. Not downloaded or tested here.
models.role: Tabular three-class expert; a separate meta-model hypothesis is possible.
models.adaptation: Fit on eligible past rows with the same UP/FLAT/DOWN target; calibrate separately; preserve the gate and fixed policy.
models.caveat: Research/internal-evaluation weight terms; a classifier is not automatically a convex expert-weight gate. Pin checkpoint and budget.
models.source_title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report — official Prior Labs release

models.name: TabPFN-3.5 Thinking upgrade
models.availability: Announced; official post says rollout starts next week and is initially API-exclusive. Availability as of 30 October is not established.
models.adaptation: If later admitted, use the same class target and account for search/inference compute as part of the trial.
models.caveat: Do not confuse this upcoming upgrade with the already released September base model or claim testing/access.
models.source_title: TabPFN-3.5-Thinking sets the new bar — official announcement

models.name: TabICLv2
models.availability: Paper first submitted on this date; revised September 2026; author record identifies ICML 2026. Official classifier/regressor checkpoints verified. Not tested here.
models.adaptation: Use the classifier on the existing eligible feature table; freeze the checkpoint; calibrate using a later past-only partition.
models.caveat: Generic tabular benchmark findings do not establish market-regime generalization; correlated rows do not increase independent time history.
models.source_title: TabICLv2: A better, faster, scalable, and open tabular foundation model

models.name: TabM
models.availability: Preprint first submitted on this date; ICLR 2025 paper and official implementation verified. Not tested here.
models.role: Trainable tabular expert or an explicitly adapted small gate.
models.adaptation: Train a bounded three-class neural model; changing its output to expert weights requires a separately tested simplex gate.
models.caveat: Parameter-efficient ensembling does not remove small-sample risk; expert and gate adaptations are different trials.
models.source_title: TabM: Advancing Tabular Deep Learning with Parameter-Efficient Ensembling

models.name: Chronos-2
models.availability: Official introduction; October 17 paper and amazon/chronos-2 model card verified. No weights downloaded here.
models.role: Multivariate/covariate forecast features or adapted classification expert.
models.adaptation: Use a validated exact-target distribution-to-class adapter or frozen features followed by a chronological classifier.
models.caveat: Future covariates must be genuinely known; marginal price quantiles do not determine the target return-ratio distribution.
models.source_title: Introducing Chronos-2: From univariate to universal forecasting — Amazon Science

models.name: TimesFM-3
models.availability: Official announcement and google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch weights card verified; non-commercial model terms. Not tested here.
models.role: Multivariate forecasting expert requiring classification adaptation.
models.adaptation: Use the same adapter and fixed downstream gate/policy as any other new forecasting expert.
models.caveat: TimesFM-2.5 is not the latest release as of review date; the original TimesFM paper is not a new TimesFM-3 paper.
models.source_title: TimesFM-3: A zero-shot foundation model for multivariate forecasting — Google Research

models.name: Moirai 2.0
models.availability: Official introduction; later November 2025 paper, February 2026 revision and official small checkpoint verified. Not tested here.
models.role: Compact quantile forecaster requiring classification adaptation.
models.adaptation: Use frozen forecast features with a three-class head or a justified return-distribution adapter.
models.caveat: Model card uses non-commercial terms; quantile interpolation, tails and execution horizon need validation.

models.name: TiRex with frozen classification features
models.availability: TiRex preprint date; NeurIPS 2025 model plus October 2025 workshop classification-transfer study and official workflow verified. Not tested here.
models.role: Frozen xLSTM sequence representation plus three-class head.
models.adaptation: Extract only observed-prefix features; train and calibrate a regularized classifier chronologically.
models.caveat: Frozen feature extraction does not make the learned market classifier zero-shot; whole-series classification differs from future-return classification.
models.source_title: TiRex: Zero-Shot Forecasting Across Long and Short Horizons with Enhanced In-Context Learning

models.name: Time-MoE
models.availability: Preprint date; ICLR 2025 status verified in author record. No local artifact qualification performed.
models.adaptation: Only an adapted expert in this proposal; retain the separate external gate over classifier outputs.
models.caveat: Internal neural-expert routing is not evidence for HMM-conditioned routing among independently trained financial classifiers.
models.source_title: Time-MoE: Billion-Scale Time Series Foundation Models with Mixture of Experts

models.name: Timer-S1
models.availability: Preprint date; revised April 2026; paper states model release. No local checkpoint/download/runtime qualification performed.
models.adaptation: Would need a bounded frozen-model trial and the same class-output adapter before admission.
models.caveat: Large total model footprint and long-context benchmarks may poorly match the local small-data controller task.
models.source_title: Timer-S1: A Billion-Scale Time Series Foundation Model with Serial Scaling

models.name: TSMamba
models.availability: Preprint verified; a usable released checkpoint was not verified in this review. Not installed or tested.
models.adaptation: Use only a fully observed context; attach a validated three-class head if artifacts become reproducible.
models.caveat: Paper availability is not weight availability; asymptotic efficiency is not measured local latency.
models.source_title: A Mamba Foundation Model for Time Series Forecasting

models.name: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning (DFF)
models.availability: AAAI 2025 proceedings publication date; primary paper verified. No project implementation or evaluation.
models.adaptation: Keep separate from the initial fixed-policy routing study; register downstream objective, constraints and adaptation budget.
models.caveat: Changing allocation and gate together confounds the proposal; decision loss can hurt probability interpretability or turnover.
models.source_title: DFF: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning for Smarter Predict-Then-Optimize with Limited Data
